value_text: FUOYE Direct Entry requires the applicable O'Level requirements plus GCE A'Level, JUPEB, OND or ND Upper Credit, as specified for each course.
answer_text: For FUOYE Direct Entry, meet your course's O'Level requirements and its accepted GCE A'Level, JUPEB, OND or ND Upper Credit qualification. The official screening guidance states that A'Level candidates need at least 6 aggregate points. These are general conditions, not confirmation that every qualification is accepted for every course. Which course do you want to study? Check the linked 2026/2027 guidance before applying.
source_name: FUOYE official 2026/2027 screening guidance — Direct Entry
evidence_text: Advanced (A) Level candidates must have at least 6 points aggregate. Direct Entry Admission Candidates must satisfy the University SSCE/NECO/GCE O/Level requirements and in addition have GCE A/Level, JUPEB, OND or ND Upper Credit as stated for each course.
